title: SvgAnimate
responsibility: Renders the native animate element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimate.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the animate element; it matters only when supplied, because the `{#if children}` guard renders nothing when it is omitted. The component performs no runtime check on the snippet, so only the Snippet type annotation constrains it.

outputs.name: SvgAnimate
outputs.description: The native SVG `animate` element: its tag is fixed to `animate`, its namespace is svg via `svelte:options`, every prop other than `children` is spread onto it, and the optional children render inside it. No wrapper element is added around it, so attributes and children apply to the animate element directly.
